_README: Website images (stock placeholders until you have your own photos). To change an image: replace 'src' with another Unsplash photo address (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-...) OR a self-hosted photo: put files named <name>-480.webp, <name>-800.webp, <name>-1200.webp, <name>-1600.webp, <name>-2000.webp in /assets/images/site/ and set 'src' to /assets/images/site/<name> (no extension). Most homepage photos are self-hosted this way; 'unsplash' keeps the original link. Update 'alt' to describe the new picture, and 'credit'/'page' if it is a new stock photo. 'position' moves the crop focus: center, top, bottom, left or right. These stock photos are decorative and are NOT presented as Amiri's own completed jobs. Licence: Unsplash Licence (free for commercial use, no permission needed). See IMAGE_CREDITS.md.
